messages.subject: Error part 4, in the milestone
parts:
Hello, I'm encountering this error, but a coworker from another institution managed to run the data on her computer. Does anyone have any insights into why this might be happening? Below is the error: 
Erro:
No milestone data found for part(s) 4. Run this/these first before running part 5.
Além disso: Mensagens de aviso:
1: In GGIR(mode = mode, datadir = datadir, outputdir = outputdir, studyname = studyname, :
Argument excludefirstlast has been provided more than once. Try to avoid this.
2: In read.gt3x: : read.gt3x(path = filename), batch_begin = starpage, :
Duplicated time índices – usually indicative of a problem
